answer: Histories are stored in ocean, checked in terrace, and trellis makes public each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 2 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 3 epochs. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
